WITH monthly_tourist_visitors AS (
    SELECT 
        YEAR(entry_date) AS year,
        MONTH(entry_date) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS tourist_visitors_count
    FROM 
        estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
    WHERE 
        (person_type = 'visitor' OR person_type IS NULL)
        AND visa_type_description = 'زيارة سياحية'
        AND entry_date >= ADD_MONTHS(NOW(), -36)
        AND entry_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 
        YEAR(entry_date),
        MONTH(entry_date)
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        tourist_visitors_count,
        LAG(tourist_visitors_count) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_month_count,
        ROUND(
            ((COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY year, month)) * 100.0) / 
            NULLIF(LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY year, month), 0), 2
        ) AS growth_rate_percentage
    FROM 
        monthly_tourist_visitors
    GROUP BY 
        year, month, tourist_visitors_count
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    tourist_visitors_count,
    prev_month_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_month_count IS NOT NULL AND prev_month_count != 0 THEN 
            ROUND(((tourist_visitors_count - prev_month_count) * 100.0) / prev_month_count, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS growth_rate_percentage
FROM 
    growth_rates
ORDER BY 
    year,
    month LIMIT 20000
